1169: Lina is the primary protagonist and the only character that appears in all incarnations of Slayers. She is an adolescent but very powerful sorceress, with a great love of money, treasure (especially the magical sort) and food.
141136: Mamako is a beta tester in the MMORPG alongside her son, Masato Oosuki who she is overprotective of. She is a very powerful adventurer, to the point that Masato often questions his role as the hero.
